headline: Names a post office in Chesterfield, Missouri, after Sgt. Zachary M. Fisher.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 16105 Swingley Ridge Road in Chesterfield, Missouri, as the "Sgt. Zachary M. Fisher Post Office." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 5, 2015.
